question: Do the eight preserved local TIFF pixel arrays equal their pinned DANDI selected series, and what preparation history is supported by available code/headers?
scope: BOI source integrity only; no event outcomes, tissue judgement, detector tuning, statistics or scientific contrast.
method: Checksum-verified pinned NWB downloads; all-pixel equality per corresponding frame. Compare direct stored row/column indexing as primary and transpose as an explicitly separate orientation diagnostic. No fitting, intensity rescaling, cropping or automatic orientation correction. Inspect first TIFF header and relevant historical/current source code.

budget.manual_review: Code/header provenance only; no event annotation

clock: Retain confirmed precise 1 Hz external triggering. Embedded timestamps do not override it; exposure and experiment alignment remain separate.
criteria: Exact archive container SHA256 and expected size before reading payload; zero unequal pixels for equality. Report every failure, difference and pending input. Equality does not prove camera-raw preparation or biological eligibility.
stopping_rule: One fixed pass. Retain current source rules; restrict equivalence claims to verified cases. Preserve failed/partial downloads and runs. Missing original conversion script remains unknown, not an invitation to infer historical settings.

completion.join_note: The parallel Python worker attempted its final join before MATLAB had produced all eight rows. Its assertion/log is preserved; this sequential join verifies the complete saved results without rerunning pixel comparisons.
